summary: Capitalise each word of a title: words of length <= 2 become lowercase, others have only the first letter uppercase.
mainInsight: Split into words, transform each according to its length, and join with single spaces. str.capitalize() already lowercases the remaining letters.

approaches.name: split + per-word rule + join
approaches.summary: Use capitalize() for len > 2 else lower().

promptVariants: Which string method uppercases the first letter and lowercases the rest?
How do you rebuild the title?
cards.explanation: capitalize() transforms one word as required by the problem.

incorrectOptionExplanations.str.title(): Title-cases words regardless of the length rule and treats apostrophes oddly.

promptVariants: Why is capitalize() safe here even for mixed-case input?
cards.answer: capitalize() makes the first character uppercase and all remaining characters lowercase, which is exactly what is needed for words longer than 2; for shorter words the whole word is lowercased.
